newsitem.title: USA: American Intl says it wins Calif. ruling.
newsitem.headline: American Intl says it wins Calif. ruling.

text.p: American International Group Inc said on Thursday that the California Superior Court has rejected a combined attempt by the California Insurance Department, Golden Eagle Insurance Co and Liberty Mutual Insurance Co to impede with its marketing in California.

In a ruling on Wednesday, the court denied the motion to enjoin American International's ongoing marketing efforts for insurance products to small and medium businesses, American International Group said.
Liberty Mutual was awarded Golden Eagle's workers' compensation business under a court ruling on May 30 -- a ruling American International is appealing.
California's Insurance Department seized control of Golden Eagle in January because of a shortfall in reserves.
American International was set to take over Golden Eagle, but a court-supervised auction of the company enabled Liberty Mutual to gain control of it.
